backup.title: Recovery backups
backup.subtitle: Safe local copies of all data. No internet needed. We keep the 10 most recent.
backup.step1: Back up now makes a safe copy of everything and checks it. A new recovery point appears in the list.
backup.step2: Restore asks you to type RESTORE {id} to confirm. We first make a safety copy of the current data and check the backup file.
backup.step3: Restore is staged for 10 minutes — new sales are paused. Confirm to apply, or it expires. If it fails, the safety copy restores automatically.
backup.step4: We auto-back up on schedule (Daily by default — change interval in Customization: Off / 6h / 12h / Daily / Weekly) and keep the 10 newest good copies. Older ones beyond 10 are deleted. Failed backups stay for checking.
backup.noBackup: No good backup yet — tap Back up now.
backup.restoreWhatHappens: What happens when you tap Restore?
backup.restoreDetail: You’ll see a confirmation prompt with the backup date and size. Type RESTORE {id} to stage it, then confirm again to replace the live data. The system makes a safety backup first, verifies everything, and blocks new sales for 10 minutes while staged.
